title: Trace coordinates with a uniform discriminant denominator
statement: Let $R\hookrightarrow S$ be a finite injective homomorphism of commutative normal domains [def-weil-finitely-generated-module, def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], put $K=\operatorname{Frac}(R)$ and $L=\operatorname{Frac}(S)$, and suppose $L/K$ is separable [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Write $n=[L:K]$ [def-weil-vector-space-dimension]. There are $b_1,\ldots,b_n\in S$ forming a $K$-basis of $L$ such that, writing $\operatorname{Tr}_{L/K}(z)$ for the trace of the $K$-linear endomorphism $x\mapsto zx$ of $L$, all $T_{ij}=\operatorname{Tr}_{L/K}(b_ib_j)$ lie in $R$ and $d=\det(T)\in R$ is nonzero. For every integral normal scheme $X$ with a morphism $X\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ inducing an identification of its function field with $K$, and every integral normal scheme $Y$ with a morphism $Y\to\operatorname{Spec}S$ inducing an identification of its function field with $L$ [def-pc-integral-scheme, def-sc-function-field] (normal means all local rings are normal domains), and every finite morphism $\pi:Y\to X$ compatible with these maps [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], field trace restricts to a morphism $\operatorname{Tr}:\pi_*\mathcal O_Y\to\mathcal O_X$. The morphism of $\mathcal O_X$-modules $\Phi:\pi_*\mathcal O_Y\to\mathcal O_X^{\oplus n}$ given by $s\mapsto(\operatorname{Tr}(b_1s),\ldots,\operatorname{Tr}(b_ns))$ is injective and its cokernel is annihilated by the pullback of $d$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].
